name: Aatrox
notes: World Ender (R) is cast at t=0 to secure its bonus AD for as much of the fight as possible; Q, W and basic attacks read their AD-scaling damage from Aatrox's current total AD at the moment they land, so the R buff amplifies them too, per the mechanic that Q/W damage is calculated from current stats.

Deathbringer Stance (P) is assumed pre-charged and ready at t=0 (the more common reading for a level-16 fight); each landed basic attack that does not consume it reduces its remaining cooldown by 2s, and a landed Q cast (assumed sweetspot, see below) or W hit reduces it by 2s/4s respectively; consuming it resets the cooldown to the full level-based value.

Every Darkin Blade (Q) cast is assumed to land its Sweetspot against the stationary dummy (maximum damage reading, doubling the Deathbringer Stance cooldown refund on each cast); Q's own cast time is not modeled beyond the standard 0.25s cast lockout, and the three casts are chained back-to-back at the 1-second static gap between casts stated for the ability, which is unaffected by ability haste.

Infernal Chains (W) is cast on cooldown; since the dummy never moves the 1.5s tether always survives, so both the initial hit and the delayed pull hit land, each dealing the base+40% AD physical damage (the wiki's literal 'the same damage again' reading) and each independently refunding 2s of Deathbringer Stance cooldown.

Umbral Dash (E) deals no damage and is used purely as an attack-timer reset, cast the instant it is off cooldown to squeeze in an extra basic attack; its passive lifesteal-style heal never changes damage dealt so it is ignored.
Mana is not modeled: none of Aatrox's abilities cost mana in this data set.
